# gramlot-py-server 0.2.9

All five adapters now pass the explicit component collections to the core server.
The gallery supplies matching Builder grammar and browser modules for the component
examples. Existing CLI commands and HTTP/RPC ownership remain unchanged.

Requires Gramlot and gramlot-examples 0.3.0 or later. Update the active environment,
including the gallery extra, and restart the server. Source checkouts also require
rebuilt browser bundles.

Verified with 102 tests across the five adapters and Chromium/WebKit gallery checks,
including typed fields, formlet, copy, touch presentation and asynchronous validation.
